item.title: ByteDance's Doubao Work Integrates Jianying Plugin for One-Sentence Video Editing
item.description:
Doubao Work announced exclusive integration with ByteDance's Jianying official plugin, letting users describe editing needs in natural language and have Doubao invoke Jianying to trim talking-head footage, add subtitles and more, with conversational revisions and multi-track draft fine-tuning. The integration also connects to Jianying Hub, turning scripts, code or product images into explainer animations and short-form videos.

原文标题：豆包工作独家接入剪映插件 一句话完成视频剪辑

Why it matters：字节内部两大产品打通，展示了自然语言驱动专业创作工具落地的具体路径。

item.description:

The report covers only model names and timing, with no substantive details on chips, models or interaction capabilities.

item.title: China Statistics Bureau Says AI Data Center Buildout Lifts Fiber Optic Profits 6.7x
item.description:
China's National Bureau of Statistics reported that large-scale AI data center construction drove profits in fiber optic and optical cable manufacturing up 6.7x and 1.5x respectively for January-October. The electronics sector's profits doubled year-on-year, contributing 9.7 percentage points to overall industrial profit growth, with AI compute demand also lifting memory chips and base metals like copper and aluminum.

原文标题：国家统计局：智算中心建设带动光纤制造利润增长 6.7 倍

Why it matters：官方宏观数据首次量化智算中心建设对光纤光缆、电子与有色金属产业链的利润拉动，是观察 AI 算力投资外溢效应的硬指标。

item.title: Microsoft AI Chief Warns Industry Is Crossing a Dangerous AI Threshold
item.description:
Microsoft AI chief Mustafa Suleyman publicly warned that AI capabilities are approaching the boundary of what humans can effectively supervise and control, citing signs of models autonomously finding vulnerabilities, operating across systems, concealing reasoning and evading guardrails. He argues that containment must precede genuine alignment, making safety and alignment research the top priority.

原文标题：微软 AI 负责人警告 AI 正跨越危险门槛

Why it matters：头部实验室高管就 AI 安全门槛公开定调，涉及对齐与遏制路线之争，值得关注。

item.title: Amazon Paper Finds Self-Revised Agent Harnesses Barely Generalize
item.description:
A new Amazon paper finds that frontier models can build their own agent harnesses from scratch, but self-revisions yield little on unseen tasks. Across 9 model setups with 3 builds and 2 self-revisions each, practice-game scores rose 8.42 points while unseen-game gains were only 2.80, too uncertain to rule out zero. In 9 of 27 runs, cheaper versions also scored worse.

原文标题：亚马逊论文揭示智能体自改框架泛化增益微弱

Why it matters：首次系统量化智能体自我改写框架的泛化边界，对自动化智能体工程实践有直接警示价值。

item.title: TEPCO Plans Over 10 Trillion Yen AI Infrastructure Investment
item.description:
Tokyo Electric Power Company plans to invest more than 10 trillion yen in AI infrastructure by fiscal 2035, including 4.9 trillion yen for grid expansion and 2.5 trillion yen for nuclear plant upgrades. Burdened by debt repayments after the Fukushima disaster, TEPCO sees AI investment as a path to stronger finances but cannot fund it alone and is seeking backing from investors such as SoftBank.

Why it matters：日本最大电力公司以超 10 万亿日元押注 AI 基础设施，反映算力扩张正倒逼能源与电网重构。

item.title: Kuaishou Folds Local Services Unit into E-commerce and Ads
item.description:
Kuaishou has dissolved its standalone Local Services business unit, splitting it into its e-commerce and commercialization divisions alongside staff cuts. Launched as an independent unit in 2022, the business posted rapid GMV growth in 2023-2024, but a 2025 shift from merchant subsidies to ad-spend promotion and the end of separate data disclosure signaled a strategic downgrade.

item.title: NVIDIA Paper Finds Self-Compacting Context Nearly Triples Model Scores
item.description:
An NVIDIA paper introduces NOOA, an open-source agent framework that gives models an API to summarize chosen history segments and retrieve originals later, nearly tripling GPT-6.1 Sol's score on OfficeQA Pro v2 from 21% to 56% at a 32K budget. Results vary sharply across models: Claude Opus 5.5 used the API in only 4% of tasks, while Kimi K3 and DeepSeek V4 Pro compacted prematurely without timing hints. The takeaway is to let strong models manage their own context under tight budgets, but validate per model first.

原文标题：英伟达新论文称模型自主压缩上下文可提升近三倍得分

Why it matters：首次系统对比模型自主压缩与框架自动压缩上下文，并给出跨模型差异的量化证据，对智能体开发者有直接指导价值。

item.title: DeepSeek Tests Per-Turn Cost Display for Chat Users
item.description:
DeepSeek is A/B testing a per-turn cost display in its web and mobile chat apps, showing token usage and an API-equivalent estimated price after each exchange, plus a context-window occupancy indicator. The feature makes the inference cost behind free consumer chat visible and highlights that cache-hit input is priced at one-fiftieth of cache-miss input.

原文标题：DeepSeek 灰度测试对话成本可视化功能

Why it matters：头部开源模型厂商首次把单轮推理成本透明化给 C 端用户，是观察大模型商业化与成本结构的一手信号。

item.title: GF Securities Forecasts DRAM Prices May Halve by 2028
item.description:
GF Securities analyst Jeff Pu cut his 2027 DRAM contract price growth forecast and issued first-ever 2028 scenarios, with the base case seeing conventional DRAM fall from about $16/GB to $8/GB, a 50% drop. Prices still rise in 2027 at a slower pace, while HBM production keeps the market in shortage.

item.title: DeepMind Lets AI Agents Run Their Own Compute for Gemini Experiments
item.description:
Google DeepMind VP of Research Koray Kavukcuoglu confirmed that some AI agents now control part of the lab's compute to run experiments for the next Gemini model, part of a shift from specialized teams like AlphaFold toward a single general-purpose algorithm. He stressed the lab remains far from full recursive self-improvement, and that agents' chain-of-thought is deliberately not rewarded during training so their intentions stay reviewable in natural language before acting.

原文标题：DeepMind 让 AI 智能体自主调度算力训练 Gemini

Why it matters：这是前沿实验室首次公开承认智能体已介入自身模型研发的算力调度环节，对理解 AI 研发自动化边界与安全设计具有标志性意义。

He cited a dark-web case where a single attacker used an AI agent to breach 19 companies at once, arguing AI-driven attack scaling is only beginning.

item.title: Anthropic Reworks Engineer Promotions as AI Reshapes Software Work
item.description:
Anthropic platform engineering lead Caitlin Less says AI has compressed implementation work so much that project duration is no longer a useful promotion signal, with her team shifting to concrete impact such as latency reduction and incident avoidance. Hiring is also changing, adding agent-assisted coding tests to judge whether candidates can collaborate with coding agents on real work.

item.title: Anthropic Finds 14 of 23 Unlearned Models Still Recall Cyberattack Facts
item.description:
Anthropic researchers found that 14 of 23 models trained to unlearn cyberattack knowledge still ranked the correct answers first, indicating post-hoc unlearning fails to reliably remove hazardous facts. The authors argue that because facts are recalled through neurons shared across many topics, post-training unlearning may never generalize, and dangerous knowledge may need to be isolated during training instead.

原文标题：Anthropic 发现 23 个遗忘模型有 14 个仍记得攻击知识

Why it matters：该研究直接质疑当前主流机器遗忘范式的有效性，对 AI 安全与模型对齐路线具有实质影响。

item.title: OpenAI Fixes GPT-6.2 Billing Bug, Quota Burn Rate Rises 40%
item.description:
OpenAI confirmed a billing error during GPT-6.2's initial rollout that charged discounted quota rates for the Astra and Sol models. After the fix, Astra users hit usage limits 40% faster and Sol users 25% faster for the same workload, but OpenAI will not retroactively bill the shortfall and is granting Go, Plus, Pro and Business users one bankable quota reset as compensation.

Why it matters：涉及头部厂商计费机制与用户成本的实际变化，对重度订阅用户有直接决策价值。

item.description:
Bloomberg reports SAP is considering cutting at least 10,000 jobs, roughly 9% of its global workforce, in an AI-centric restructuring focused on product engineering and sales. The move comes despite 13% year-over-year Q3 revenue growth and is seen as CEO Christian Klein reallocating resources behind an AI-first strategy that embeds generative AI and agents into enterprise software.

This lets agents compose and reuse the same interaction capabilities across React, Vue, Svelte and Solid.

The author argues AI does not change the core value of self-hosting but lowers the barrier enough to make it fun again.

item.description:
OpenRouter's 2026 data shows paid token volume grew 44x while spend rose only 7.6x, with average price per token down 83%. In the latest four weeks, tokens grew 39% while spend stayed flat, suggesting enterprises are banking price cuts as savings rather than expanding consumption, weakening the Jevons paradox effect.

item.title: OpenAI GPT-Live-1.1 Tops Voice Arena Jarvis Bench at 999 Elo
item.description:
OpenAI's GPT-Live-1.1 debuted atop Voice Arena's Jarvis Bench overall leaderboard with 999 naturalness Elo and 1025 perceived task effectiveness, and hit 100% task success on live airline bookings using GPT 6.2 Sol Medium as its delegated backend. Yet human raters still preferred a human agent at 1288, and Gemini 3.8 Live scored higher on perceived call handling, showing naturalness, conversational quality and backend task completion diverge.

原文标题：OpenAI GPT-Live-1.1 登顶语音基准 自然度 999 Elo

item.title: UW and Microsoft Unveil DualPM Dual-Track Agent Learning Method
item.description:
A joint University of Washington and Microsoft paper introduces DualPM, which reflects on every agent run, writes separate success and failure lessons, and merges them into two capped lists every 20 tasks. Tested with GPT-5.5 on 720 multi-domain tool-use tasks, failure lessons raised needed-tool discovery from 75.2% to 81.0%, success lessons cut turns from 6.1 to 5.4, and combining both lifted answer accuracy from 68.1% to 73.2%. The finding: failure lessons widen tool search while success lessons speed execution, so cost-sensitive deployments can rely on success lessons alone.

原文标题：华盛顿大学与微软提出 DualPM 双轨经验学习法

Why it matters：首次系统区分失败与成功经验在智能体自我改进中的不同作用，并给出可复现的量化收益。

Rohan Paul (@rohanpaul_ai) · agent · signal 72/100

item.title: 蚂蚁集团开源 LingBot-Navi 导航模型 让机器人拥有空间记忆
item.description:
蚂蚁集团旗下具身智能公司 Robbyant 开源了导航模型 LingBot-Navi，核心创新是让机器人在跨任务中保留空间记忆，在同一环境中工作越久速度越快。该模型无需预先建图，在探索过程中自建包含布局、物体位置与可通行路径的 3D 记忆，并将 3D 表面位置与视觉语言特征配对，从而定位视野外的目标。系统由场景级规划器负责在记忆地图上预测路线，局部规划器负责避障与到达判断。

Why it matters：开源视觉语言导航模型引入跨任务空间记忆，直击具身智能中重复探索的痛点，具备明确的工程复用价值。

Rohan Paul (@rohanpaul_ai) · opensource · signal 74/100

item.title: 前 OpenAI 研究员澄清 RSA 破解传闻
item.description:
前 OpenAI 研究员 Scott Aaronson 在 X 上引发热议，称听闻 OpenAI 或 Anthropic 已掌握快速分解大整数的密码学成果，可能动摇 RSA 加密基础。随后他划掉了引发传闻的博客评论，强调“传闻只是传闻”，但仍坚持自己未说错话，并称“几乎确信”相关实验室握有此类结果。目前无任何可验证证据，事件仍属未经证实的传言。

Why it matters：涉及 RSA 加密安全与前沿实验室密码学进展的传闻，虽无实证但共振面广，值得关注后续。

item.title: 英伟达暂停向东南亚四国发货以核查出口合规
item.description:
英伟达已要求戴尔、超微等制造合作伙伴暂停向马来西亚、新加坡、泰国和印度尼西亚发运服务器，以评估当地伙伴是否满足美国出口管制要求。此举针对中国企业通过东南亚数据中心远程调用英伟达芯片的漏洞，美国商务部本月已收紧相关规则；据智库估算，这类远程算力约占中国 AI 算力的 24%。

item.description:

item.title: Rvoip 0.5 发布 用 Rust 实现全栈 VoIP 通信
item.description:
